style_anchor_prompt: Create a polished Microsoft Fluent-inspired dark visual system for a Hackathon presentation. Deep charcoal and navy background inspired by a professional coding workspace, Fluent blue primary accents, cyan highlights, selective Copilot green, Claude orange, Gemini blue, and purple accents. Use dark rounded panels, subtle luminous borders, restrained soft glow, crisp white typography, spacious composition, approachable developer and robot illustrations. Keep it friendly and enterprise-ready, never heavy cyberpunk or sci-fi. Do not include Microsoft logos. All visible text must be English.
